164.long_description:
We have updated our monitor firmware which is now customized for different Arcooda monitors. Whilst the original low resolution engine is shared between the models, with a variety of new features being introduced, monitor series will be starting with A, B, C...

Previously we maintained the one software version (V series), however, with functions such as mirror, FreeSync Pro, DDCI, etc not all chipsets/boards can handle the same functions, one solution cannot match all our monitors.  

With this, the new firmware series will be as below;


A Series - 26inch 1440x1080
B Series - 35inch 1440x1080
C Series - 26inch UHD 2880x2160
D Series - 35inch UHD 2880x2160

E Series - 29inch 1600x1200
V Series - 19inch, 20inch, 23.8inch, 32inch, 43inch and 55inch monitors


By pressing the Menu button, or the HotKey specifications button, you can see the firmware version your monitor currently has. Please note, firmware can only be updated in new monitor productions, or by special arrangement. 

All monitors shipped come with the latest firmware.
